owner: one process-private shared activity word per opt-in collector
deterministic_path: Publish activity; never wait for an acknowledgment or for inference.
on_expiry: Fail as WRITER_DEFERRED; do not advance the checkpoint; attempt degraded-state persistence only when idle. A later scheduler probe submits fresh bounded replay.
retry_queue: None; one active job, existing spacing and transient backoff.
residual_race: A collector may begin after the check or after shadow acquired the lock; other processes and heartbeat writes are not coordinated.
